newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Noven lowered to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Noven lowered to neutral.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw analyst James Keeney said in a research note he lowered his recommendation on Noven Pharmaceuticals to neutral from buy.

-- "Noven management was informing analysts last night of a shortfall in fourth quarter 1996 product sales of estrogen patches due to inventory buildup by Novartis (AG ) and Rhone-Poulenc Rorer (Inc ). The sales shortfall is approximately $1 million from the approximate $5.5 million in product sales in each of the first three quarters of 1996."
-- Shares were off three to eight in vigourous Nasdaq trade.
-- The analyst said he lowered his 1997 revenue estimate to $23 million from $38 million.
-- He also slashed the 1997 earnings estimate to a loss of $0.10 per share from a profit of $0.40 per share.
